- Added exercise recognition and calorie analysis for workout logging.
- Introduced an exercise analyzer module.

Initial project commit with full repository structure.

- Added complete .git directory and version control history.
- No changes to skill logic or documentation in SKILL.md.
- Lays foundation for future code development and collaboration.

- Changed eating record workflow: now asks users to confirm before saving food logs, instead of saving immediately without confirmation.
- Only stores data after explicit user approval.
- Confirmation is not required for every operation if the user has already granted ongoing permission.
- Clarified confirmation process in the skill's documentation for data creation.

Initial release of calorie-tracker, an intelligent nutrition management system.

- Supports food recognition via text, images, and voice input.
- Provides nutritional analysis (calories, protein, fat, carbs) and daily intake tracking.
- Features immediate, automated logging of meals without user confirmation.
- Allows users to query, update, and delete historical meal records.
- Modular design includes food analysis and persistent data storage via API.
